dict.string: BugHunterClaudex uses the microphone when you turn on local voice input in Chat. Audio is processed locally and is not saved. Stop listening or Stop all turns it off.
BugHunterClaudex can control the Mac application you explicitly select during a time-limited task. You can stop it at any time.
BugHunterClaudex can capture your screen only when you request a local screenshot for your selected application workflow.
